name: Cable Girls
s: In 1920s Madrid, four women at the National Telephone Company ring in revolution as they manage romance, friendship and the modern workplace.

paragraphs.text: Cable Girls () is a Spanish period drama television series that ran from April 2017 and concluded in July 2020. Set in the late 1920s, it stars Ana Fernández, Nadia de Santiago, Blanca Suárez and Maggie Civantos.
The first season, consisting of eight episodes, premiered on Netflix, worldwide, on 28 April 2017.
The first half of the fifth and final season was released on Netflix, on 14 February 2020.
The second half of the fifth and final season was released on Netflix on 3 July 2020.
